2026-08-05.title: Kendra sarkar ki GOBARdhan yojana ki shuruaat
bullets: Kendra sarkar ne GOBARdhan yojana ki shuruaat ki hai
Is yojana ke liye 23,731 crore rupe ka outlay hai
Is yojana ka uddeshya compressed biogas utpaadan ko badhava dena hai

2026-08-05.title: Agni-4 ballistic missile ka parikshan
bullets: Bharat ne Agni-4 ballistic missile ka parikshan kiya hai
Is missile ki range 4000 kilometer hai
Is missile ka upyog desh ke raksha ke liye kiya jayega

2026-08-05.title: RBI ne UPI payment par charge ko lekar bayan diya
bullets: RBI ne UPI payment par charge ko lekar bayan diya hai
RBI ne kaha hai ki UPI payment par koi charge nahi lagaya jayega
Is faisale se upbhoktaon ko fayda hoga

2026-08-05.title: BRICS sammelan ki shuruaat
bullets: BRICS sammelan ki shuruaat hui hai
Is sammelan mein 15 deshon ke pratinidhi bhag le rahe hain
Is sammelan ka uddeshya vishv ki arthik sthiti par charcha karna hai

2026-08-05.title: Glaw lake ko Ramsar site ki maanyata
bullets: Glaw lake ko Ramsar site ki maanyata di gayi hai
Is lake ki visheshata hai ki yahan koi bhi nahin doobta
Is lake ki raksha ke liye kadam uthaye jayenge

2026-08-05.title: Tiger reserve mein shaavakon ki sankhya badhane ke liye prayaas
bullets: Tiger reserve mein shaavakon ki sankhya badhane ke liye prayaas kiye ja rahe hain
Iske liye vishesh prajaati ke shaavakon ko laaya ja raha hai
Isse tiger reserve ki jaanwaron ki sankhya badhegi

2026-08-05.title: Kendra sarkar ne police balon ke aadhunikikaran ki yojana ko maanjuri di
bullets: Kendra sarkar ne police balon ke aadhunikikaran ki yojana ko maanjuri di hai
Is yojana ke liye 500 crore rupe ka outlay hai
Is yojana se police balon ki kshamta badhegi

2026-08-06.title: Kendra Sarkar Ne FCRA Bill Ko Dharm-Nirpekshta Kaha
bullets: Ghar Vibhag Ne Christian Sansthaon Ko Vishwas Dilaya Hai Ki Sarkar Ki Is Bill Ka Udeshya Kisi Bhi Dharmik Samuday Ko Pareshan Karna Nahi Hai
FCRA Bill Mein Deemed Cessation Of Assets Ka Clause Shaamil Hai, Jiske Bare Mein Charcha Ho Rahi Hai
Is Bill Ka Mukhya Udeshya Foreign Funding Ko Niyantrit Karna Aur Iske Durdupayog Ko Rokna Hai

2026-08-06.title: Rajya Sabha Ne Appropriation Bill Pas Kiya
bullets: Is Bill Ke Tahat Kendra Sarkar 54,067 Crore Rupaye Ka Vyaay Karegi
Vitt Mantri Nirmala Sitharaman Ne Kahaa Hai Ki Kendra Sarkar Ne Kashmir Ke Vittiya Jarurat Ka Dhyan Rakha Hai
Is Bill Ka Udeshya Kendra Sarkar Dwara Vittiya Varsh 2023-24 Ke Liye Aay-Vyaay Ka Anuman Lagana Hai

2026-08-06.title: Kendra Sarkar Ne RERA Cases Mein Revenue Recovery Ko Badhava Dene Ke Liye Naye SOP Aur Software Launch Kiye
bullets: Naye SOP Ka Udeshya RERA Adhiniyam 2016 Ke Section 40(2) Ko Laagu Karna Hai
Iske Tahat RERA Apne Aadeshon Ko Laagu Karne Ke Liye Pradhan Civil Court Ke Saman Adhikar Rakhega
Is Naye Prabandhan Se RERA Cases Mein Revenue Recovery Mein Tezi Aayegi

2026-08-06.title: CBI Ne Tech-Support Fraud Case Mein 4 Logon Ko Giraftaar Kiya
bullets: CBI Ne Punjab Aur Delhi Mein 10 Sthano Par Chhaapa Maari Hai
Is Case Mein CBI Ne Kuchh Incriminating Dastavez Aur Bank Account Details Seized Kiye Hain
CBI Ne Is Case Mein Agarvaal Aur Vigilance Kaam Kar Raha Hai

2026-08-06.title: PM Modi Ne Rashtriya Haathkargha Diwas Par Logon Se Haathkargha Utsav Manane Ki Apeksha Ki
bullets: PM Modi Ne Apne Instagram Account Par Haathkargha Utsav Ki Jankari Di Hai
Unhone Haathkargha Utsav Ke Liye Desh Ke Vibhinn Bhagyon Se Haathkargha Saamagri Ki Tasveerein Sajhai Hain
Haathkargha Utsav Ka Udeshya Haathkargha Udyog Ko Badhava Dena Aur Haathkargha Kala Ko Sanrakshit Karna Hai
